confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge; no live menus, listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and coffee anchors are the firmest; hostel and hotel anchors vary widely with July demand and neighborhood. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.5x beer, wine glass about 1.1x beer) because direct price knowledge is weaker. FX was taken from RBA pages as surfaced in search results, not from a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: Loosely benchmarked against southern European capitals such as Lisbon, with dining and drink prices set from general knowledge of Athens and accommodation adjusted for July peak demand.
